kwalitatief_lbo_oordeel: Fictitious demo text. A growing, cash-generative family business with a clean balance sheet and no financial debt. The bank tests hold at about 2.2x senior in the stress case, but the indicative price leaves little headroom at a 20% IRR, so the case depends on the price and on how much of the founders' role can be replaced.
investment_thesis: Revenue grew about 10% a year with a rising EBITDA margin (16% to 18%): operating leverage on an existing plant.
No financial debt and EUR 3.2m cash: room for about 2.2x senior debt that the stress case still services.
Founder-owned with no group ties (Primary deal): a clean succession buy-out with a vendor loan.

dd_vragen.vraag: What are the contract terms and renewal dates of the three largest customers, and is there a change-of-control clause?
What would a hired CEO and CFO cost, and will the founders stay on after closing?
What is the market rent of the plant, and can a long lease at that rent be signed before closing?
Which part of the 2024 growth comes from the new production line, and what is its order backlog?
Is the 2024 non-recurring cost of EUR 180k truly one-off?
